issues: [code-quality] routetoholder.go ~196-200: the duplicate-RequestID path in PreRequest releases the earlier pin and deletes the inflight entry, but if the earlier request was unconfirmed its loading[adapter] on its pod is never cleared, inflating len(lru)+len(loading) and suppressing the next cold-miss eviction. Fix: apply the same D13 abort handling (clear loading unless otherPending) before dropping it, and add a test (PreRequest '1' x podA unconfirmed, then PreRequest '1' y podB; podA loading/pins empty, podB pinned+loading for y).
reviews.summary: Fidelity, accessor choices, registration, config and assembly all pass; only the duplicate-RequestID branch leaks a pending load and lacks a test.
